content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Deputy Commissioner Tuensang Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://ipr.nagaland.gov.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 22-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Deputy Commissioner Tuensang MTS recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the application form is 22nd October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated office before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the MTS post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) position is passing Class VIII.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the MTS post?
faq.answer: The age limit is between a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 37 years as of 1st July 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for government employees.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any age relaxation for government employees?
faq.answer: Yes, serving government employees can avail of age relaxation equal to their years of service, up to a maximum of 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the MTS post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be appointed at Pay Level-1 (one) of the Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the MTS position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. You need to obtain the application form from the Establishment Branch, Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Tuensang, and submit it by the last date.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I get the application form?
faq.answer: Application forms will be issued from the Establishment Branch, Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Tuensang, between 21st September 2026 and 21st October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required with the application form?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates. Refer to the official notification for a complete list.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the MTS recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an examination. The exact date and venue will be communicated through the admit card.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a specific district requirement for applicants?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants must be Indigenous Inhabitants of Tuensang District.
